notes.title: Bug fixes + troubleshooting
notes.content:
【Fixes】
・ Volume settings and language settings are now saved.
・Fixed minor bugs.


【Reported troubles and remedies】
■When using HDR, the screen may turn white and nothing may be displayed.
Please turn off HDR in Windows settings.

■"Startup has been canceled. Please delete your save data and try again."
If you are unable to start the game due to this error, please try deleting the following save data in your local files.
・otutome_sakuya_sf.sav
・otutome_sakuya_tyrano_data.bk.sav
・otutome_sakuya_tyrano_data.sav
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925311/0044f2ed2ca0d8616e9c309f38dbbcd781c65eff.png[/img]

■If you are still unable to play the game due to some trouble, we apologize.
There is video data with the same content as the game in ■■■mp4■■■ in the local file.
Please take a look there.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925311/d595a2a81fb563d798c6900dcc51d8b6b73bbcc8.png[/img]
